     
# About Us

        
Welcome to shopping99.in, where we redefine affordable footwear by blending craftsmanship with accessibility. At shopping99.in, our mission is to bring stylish, high-quality sneakers to everyone at an unbeatable price of just ₹99. Based on the philosophy of individuality and practicality, we craft lightweight, non-slip sneakers designed for men and women who value comfort, durability, and fashion without breaking the bank.

        Our journey began with a simple idea: footwear should be both personal and affordable. Unlike traditional brands that focus on luxury at a premium, shopping99.in bridges the gap by offering meticulously designed shoes that reflect your unique style. From casual comfort shoes to running sneakers and fashion-forward slip-ons, our collection is tailored to meet the diverse needs of our customers. Each pair is crafted with breathable materials, wear-resistant soles, and thoughtful detailing to ensure you step confidently into every moment of your.
        
        
What sets us apart is our commitment to quality at an accessible price point. We believe that everyone deserves footwear that enhances their lifestyle, whether you're hiking outdoors, running errands, or stepping out in style. Our team of skilled artisans works tirelessly to maintain the highest standards of craftsmanship, using innovative techniques and carefully selected materials like mesh, canvas, and air-cushioned platforms. Every shoe we produce is a testament to our motto: “Claim your own fame”—a call to express your individuality through footwear that’s as unique as you are.

        
At shopping99.in, we’re more than just an online shoe store; we’re a community of footwear enthusiasts who value elegance, exclusivity, and experience. Our website showcases a curated selection of base styles, from low-top canvas shoes to outdoor hiking sneakers, allowing you to explore a variety of designs that suit your personality. With a focus on sustainability and customer satisfaction, we aim to deliver not just shoes, but an experience that empowers you to walk your own path.

        Our process is rooted in transparency and passion. We source materials that prioritize comfort—like breathable mesh and lightweight fabrics—while ensuring durability with non-slip soles and wear-resistant finishes. Whether it’s a pair of casual sneakers for men or a chic platform design for women, every product reflects our dedication to affordable excellence. shopping99.in is proud to be powered by KVB Enterprise, a company that shares our vision of making quality footwear accessible to all.
        
        
Join us on this journey as we continue to innovate and expand our offerings. Explore our collection today and discover why shopping99.in is the go-to destination for affordable, stylish sneakers that don’t compromise on quality. From the streets to the trails, we’re here to help you leave your mark—one step at a time.

# Contact Us



        
        
## Facing an issue?

        
If you’re facing trouble with placing an order, deciding which shoe to buy, tracking your shipment, or any other urgent matters related to your shopping experience with shopping99.in, we’ve got you covered. Drop us an email at contact@shopping99.in, and our dedicated support team will respond promptly to sort it out for you. Whether it’s a question about our lightweight, non-slip sneakers priced at just ₹99, or assistance with returns, we’re here to ensure your experience is seamless and hassle-free.

        
Please include your order number (if applicable) and a brief description of your issue to help us assist you faster.

        


        
        
## Just want to say hello?

        
We love hearing from our community! Whether you have feedback about our affordable sneakers, suggestions for new styles, or simply want to chat about your favorite pair from our collection, feel free to hit us up at contact@shopping99.in. Our team is passionate about connecting with customers who share our love for stylish, practical footwear.

        
Tell us your story—how do our sneakers fit into your daily life? We’re excited to hear from you and build a stronger bond with our shopping99.in family!

        


        
        
## Where We Operate

        
We proudly operate our business from multiple hubs across India, including Surat, Mumbai, and Delhi. These strategic locations allow us to efficiently manage our inventory of breathable, durable sneakers and ensure swift delivery to customers nationwide. While we don’t have physical stores you can visit, our online platform at **shopping99.in** brings our full range of ₹99 footwear directly to your doorstep, no matter where you are in India.

        


        
        
## Important Security Notices

        
At shopping99.in, your security is our priority. We want to make it clear that we never ask for sensitive payment information such as credit or debit card details, UPI credentials, or any kind of OTP (One-Time Password) via email or other unofficial channels. All transactions are securely processed through our website, and we’ll never request this information outside of that context.

        
Please be aware that we do not maintain a calling customer care service. If you encounter any phone numbers listed online claiming to be shopping99.in’s customer care, they are not authentic. Do not share any bank details, card information, or personal data with them. For all legitimate support, use our official email contact@shopping99.in, and we’ll take care of you directly.

        


        
        
## Our Commitment to You

        
Our mission goes beyond selling affordable sneakers—we’re here to provide exceptional support every step of the way. Whether you’re inquiring about our mesh air cushion platform sneakers for women or our casual hiking shoes for men, we aim to respond to all emails within 24-48 hours. Your satisfaction drives us, and we’re committed to making your shopping99.in experience as enjoyable as slipping into a pair of our stylish, comfortable shoes!

        


        
        
shopping99.in Powered By KVB Enterprise. 
 E-mail: contact@shopping99.in

   
# Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)



        
        Q. Dispatch & Delivery Time?
        A. On the same working day for dispatching. After dispatching, delivery time depends on the courier partner and your distance.


Q. Serviceable Pincode for Delivery?
A. We ship products everywhere.


Q. Available Payment Method?
A. Cash on Delivery option only.


Q. Return-Refund Option?
A. Available with a simple request via email.


Q. Period For Return Request?
A. 7 days after receiving the order.


Q. Order Cancellation Option?
A. Available with a simple request via email.


Q. Order Tracking Option?
A. After dispatch, you can track further with the courier’s website using their tracking details, which you will receive via SMS.


Q. How durable are my shoes?
A. A pair of shoes can take a beating and keep on ticking in your everyday life. However, we don’t recommend going camping, trekking, or working out in them. Base-jumping safe!


Q. How long will a pair of shoes last me?
A. Pretty long, longer than your last relationship. Just give them love & care and occasionally caress them!


Q. How comfortable are my shoes?
A. The soles are shockproof, water-resistant, flexible, and extremely lightweight. The insoles are cushiony and distribute the weight of your body evenly, offering best-in-class comfort. Long story short – like walking on pillows!


Q. Are shoes weather-resistant?
A. Shoes are good for any weather and remain breathable and airy, regardless of the season. Just don’t go skiing in them!


Q. What colors do shoes come in?
A. We have multiple colors in each style. You can refer to the product pages of each style to see our complete range of available color blends. Awe guaranteed!


Q. Will the color of my shoes bleed or fade?
A. Shoe uppers have been tested for color fastness and fade resistance. To keep them looking as good as new, treat them like a child, your own child!


Q. Are shoes eco-friendly?
A. Shoes are made of modern materials like most high-end shoes. We are working on an eco-friendly line, stay tuned!


Q. Can shoes be used for athletic purposes like running, gym, and training?
A. Shoes are all-day sneakers, best for wearing comfortably throughout the day. They are optimized to provide over 14 hours of comfort. However, we do not recommend them for gym/training/running. Recommended for crossing roads and getting stuff done!


Q. Will I sweat a lot in shoes?
A. The breathable uppers will ensure you are comfortable even in hot conditions. Shoes have been tested in the deserts of Dubai, no jokes!




**Any other questions?** For any other questions, please drop us an email at contact@shopping99.in.


⚠️ We never ask for any credit/debit card number, OTP, PIN, CVV, etc.


# Privacy Policy

    
Last updated: **November 14, 2024**


    
This Privacy Policy describes Our policies and procedures on the collection, use and disclosure of Your information when You use the Service and tells You about Your privacy rights and how the law protects You. We use Your Personal Data to provide and improve the Service. By using the Service, You agree to the collection and use of information in accordance with this Privacy Policy.


    

    
      
## Interpretation and Definitions

      
### Interpretation

      
The words of which the initial letter is capitalized have meanings defined under the following conditions. The following definitions shall have the same meaning regardless of whether they appear in singular or in plural.


      
### Definitions

      

        - **Account** means a unique account created for You to access our Service or parts of our Service.

        - **Affiliate** means an entity that controls, is controlled by or is under common control with a party, where "control" means ownership of 50% or more of the shares, equity interest or other securities entitled to vote for election of directors or other managing authority.

        - **Business** (CCPA/CPRA) refers to the Company as the legal entity that collects Consumers' personal information and determines the purposes and means of processing.

        - **CCPA** and/or **CPRA** refer to the California Consumer Privacy Act as amended by the California Privacy Rights Act.

        - **Company** ("the Company", "We", "Us" or "Our") refers to **KVB Enterprise**, Surat, Gujarat, India. For the purpose of the GDPR, the Company is the Data Controller.

        - **Consumer** (CCPA/CPRA) means a California resident.

        - **Cookies** are small files placed on Your device by a website, containing details of Your browsing history among other uses.

        - **Country** refers to Gujarat, India.

        - **Data Controller** (GDPR) means the legal person which determines the purposes and means of processing Personal Data.

        - **Device** means any device that can access the Service such as a computer, cellphone, or digital tablet.

        - **Do Not Track (DNT)** is a browser preference relating to tracking across sites.

        - **GDPR** refers to the EU General Data Protection Regulation.

        - **Personal Data** is any information that relates to an identified or identifiable individual. GDPR and CCPA/CPRA definitions apply as relevant.

        - **Service** refers to the Website.

        - **Service Provider** means any natural or legal person who processes data on behalf of the Company.

        - **Third-party Social Media Service** refers to any website or social network used to log in or create an account.

        - **Usage Data** refers to data collected automatically (e.g., page visits, device identifiers).

        - **Website** refers to **shopping99.in**, accessible from https://shopping99.in.

        - **You** means the individual accessing or using the Service. Under GDPR, You may be referred to as the Data Subject.

      

    

    
      
## Collecting and Using Your Personal Data

      
        
### Types of Data Collected – Personal Data

        
While using Our Service, We may ask You to provide certain personally identifiable information that can be used to contact or identify You, including:

        

          - Email address

          - First and last name

          - Phone number

          - Address, State, Province, ZIP/Postal code, City

          - Usage Data

        

      

      
        
### Usage Data

        
Usage Data is collected automatically when using the Service and may include IP address, browser type and version, pages visited, time and date of visit, time spent, unique device identifiers, and diagnostic data. When accessing via a mobile device, additional data such as device type, OS, and browser may be collected.

      

      
        
### Information from Third-Party Social Media Services

        
If You register or log in via Google, Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, or LinkedIn, We may collect information associated with that account (e.g., name, email, activities, contacts). If You choose to share additional data with Us, You permit Us to use, share, and store it in accordance with this Policy.

      

      
        
### Tracking Technologies and Cookies

# Cookie Policy

        
This document was last updated on April 29, 2023



        
This cookie policy (“Policy”) describes what cookies are and how they’re being used by the **shopping99.in** website (“Website” or “Service”) and any of its related products and services (collectively, “Services”). This Policy is a legally binding agreement between you (“User”, “you” or “your”) and **KVB Enterprise** (doing business as “shopping99.in”, “we”, “us” or “our”). If you are entering into this agreement on behalf of a business or other legal entity, you represent that you have the authority to bind such entity to this agreement, in which case the terms “User”, “you” or “your” shall refer to such entity. If you do not have such authority, or if you do not agree with the terms of this agreement, you must not accept this agreement and may not access and use the Website and Services.



        
You should read this Policy so you can understand the types of cookies we use, the information we collect using cookies, and how that information is used. It also describes the choices available to you regarding accepting or declining the use of cookies. For further information on how we use, store and keep your personal data secure, see our privacy policy.



        




## What are cookies?


Cookies are small pieces of data stored in text files that are saved on your computer or other devices when websites are loaded in a browser. They are widely used to remember you and your preferences, either for a single visit (through a “session cookie”) or for multiple repeat visits (using a “persistent cookie”).


Session cookies are temporary cookies that are used during the course of your visit to the Website, and they expire when you close the web browser. Persistent cookies are used to remember your preferences within our Website and remain on your desktop or mobile device even after you close your browser or restart your computer. They ensure a consistent and efficient experience for you while visiting the Website and Services.


Cookies may be set by the Website (“first-party cookies”), or by third parties, such as those who serve content or provide advertising or analytics services on the Website (“third-party cookies”). These third parties can recognize you when you visit our website and also when you visit certain other websites.






## What type of cookies do we use?


### Necessary cookies


Necessary cookies allow us to offer you the best possible experience when accessing and navigating through our Website and using its features. For example, these cookies let us recognize that you have created an account and have logged into that account to access the content.




### Functionality cookies


Functionality cookies let us operate the Website and Services in accordance with the choices you make. For example, we will recognize your username and remember how you customized the Website and Services during future visits.




### Analytical cookies


These cookies enable us and third-party services to collect aggregated data for statistical purposes on how our visitors use the Website. These cookies do not contain personal information such as names and email addresses and are used to help us improve your user experience of the Website.




### Social media cookies


Third-party cookies from social media sites (such as Facebook, Twitter, etc.) let us track social network users when they visit or use the Website and Services or share content, by using a tagging mechanism provided by those social networks. These cookies are also used for event tracking and remarketing purposes. Any data collected with these tags will be used in accordance with our and social networks’ privacy policies. We will not collect or share any personally identifiable information from the user.






## What are your cookie options?


If you don’t like the idea of cookies or certain types of cookies, you can change your browser’s settings to delete cookies that have already been set and to not accept new cookies. Visit internetcookies.in to learn more about how to do this.


Please note, however, that if you delete cookies or do not accept them, you might not be able to use all of the features the Website and Services offer.






## Changes and amendments


We reserve the right to modify this Policy or its terms related to the Website and Services at any time at our discretion. When we do, we will send you an email to notify you. We may also provide notice to you in other ways at our discretion, such as through the contact information you have provided. An updated version of this Policy will be effective immediately upon the posting of the revised Policy unless otherwise specified. Your continued use of the Website and Services after the effective date of the revised Policy (or such other act specified at that time) will constitute your consent to those changes.






## Acceptance of this policy


You acknowledge that you have read this Policy and agree to all its terms and conditions. By accessing and using the Website and Services, you agree to be bound by this Policy. If you do not agree to abide by the terms of this Policy, you are not authorized to access or use the Website and Services.






## Contacting us


If you have any questions, concerns, or complaints regarding this Policy, we encourage you to contact us using the details below:

# Refund and Returns Policy





## Easy Return


At shopping99.in, we strive to ensure your satisfaction with our lightweight, non-slip sneakers priced at just ₹99. Returns are available with a simple request via email to make the process as hassle-free as possible. If you’re not completely satisfied with your purchase—whether it’s due to fit, style, or any other reason—you can initiate a return within 7 days of receiving your order.


To start, please send an email to contact@shopping99.in with your order number and a brief explanation of why you’re returning the item. Once approved, we’ll provide you with detailed instructions for shipping the product back to us. The sneakers must be unused, in their original packaging, and in the same condition as when you received them to qualify for a return.


We offer a full refund upon successful return pickup, ensuring you’re not left out of pocket. After we receive and inspect the returned item to confirm it meets our return conditions, your refund will be processed within 5-7 business days. The amount will be credited back to your original payment method (e.g., Cash on Delivery adjustments).


Please note that shipping costs for returning the item are the responsibility of the customer unless the product was defective or incorrectly shipped. If you encounter any issues during the return process, our support team is here to assist you promptly.






## Order Cancellation


Orders can be easily canceled by sending a request via email, giving you flexibility and control over your purchase. If you change your mind or need to cancel for any reason, simply email us at contact@shopping99.in with your order number and a cancellation request before the order is dispatched.


Since we aim to ship orders on the same working day, please submit your cancellation as soon as possible to ensure it’s processed in time. Once the order is dispatched, cancellation is no longer possible, but you can still opt for a return following our Easy Return policy above.


Upon successful cancellation, any payments made will be refunded within 5-7 business days, ensuring a smooth and transparent experience.






## Shipping Policy


At shopping99.in, we prioritize fast and reliable shipping to get your affordable sneakers to you quickly. Orders are shipped on the same working day if placed before our daily cutoff time (typically 2 PM IST, Monday through Saturday, excluding public holidays). Once dispatched, your order is handed over to our trusted courier partners, and delivery typically takes 3-4 days, depending on your location within India.


You’ll receive tracking details via SMS or email, allowing you to monitor your package’s journey on the courier’s website. Shipping is free on all orders, reflecting our commitment to keeping your costs low while delivering high-quality footwear.


In rare cases of delays due to unforeseen circumstances (e.g., weather or logistical issues), we’ll keep you informed and work to resolve any issues swiftly.






## Contact Us


If you have any questions regarding our Refund and Returns Policy, or need assistance with a return, cancellation, or shipping inquiry, our team is here to help. Feel free to reach out to us at any time—we’re committed to making your experience with shopping99.in as smooth as possible.


You can contact us via email at contact@shopping99.in. Please include your order number and a detailed description of your query for faster assistance. We aim to respond to all emails within 24-48 hours, ensuring you get the support you need for your lightweight, non-slip sneakers priced at just ₹99.
